correctness.rationale: Direct payoff comparison gives all four 2n-state transition rates. Under the strict multiplier bound a single cooperative block cannot disappear, a defector block decreases to one or two, and its boundary class is positive and irreducible. The full-cycle affinity reduces to a step-two product, which cancels exactly for binary edge types on each orbit. Positive detailed-balance recursion yields the unique stationary law. A three-type explicit pattern gives affinity 77/75. Exact arithmetic checks 1,008 environments and 16,320 balance equations, supplementing rather than replacing the proof.

value.rationale: Binary (high/low) environmental labels are a natural two-game baseline for public-goods transitions. Exact reversibility for arbitrary label arrangements is a structural law, not an ad hoc finite table, and the three-label ratio 77/75 shows a genuinely distinct stationary-current regime. The strict trapping threshold and computable stationary defector occupancy have direct long-run model interpretation.
